columns.doc: 1 when a ref to one may carry `@rev`.

columns.name: wikilinks
columns.doc: JSON array of its `[[prefix:…]]` sugar (`git` for `commit`).

columns.name: resolve
columns.doc: The view whose `title` names one, by its `ref` column; NULL for a core kind.

columns.name: page
columns.doc: The page that opens one (`page:ext.<extension>.<page>`, given `?ref=`); NULL for a core kind.

columns.name: icon
columns.doc: Its icon's name (one of `REF_KIND_ICONS`); NULL for a core kind.

columns.name: searchable
columns.doc: The view whose rows (`ref`, `title`, `body`) the site-wide search indexes under the kind; NULL for a core kind (core indexes its own) and for a plugin kind that isn't searchable.

columns.name: revision
columns.doc: The VCS revision the captured tree equals (`git:<sha>`): set when the workspace was clean at the head; NULL otherwise.

columns.name: tree_hash
columns.doc: Whole-tree identity: two snapshots with the same tree_hash hold the same files. NULL before V96.

columns.name: snapshot_id
columns.doc: Snapshot the worktree is at after the take (v_snapshot.id).

columns.name: parent_snapshot_id
columns.doc: Snapshot the worktree was at just before this take; parent → snapshot is what THIS take recorded (for a turn's changes use v_agent_turn.start_snapshot_id → snapshot_id).

columns.name: trigger
columns.doc: Why: turn_end, quiet, effort_start, effort_end, startup, manual, git_refs, head_moved, legacy.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: Thread the take belongs to, if any.

columns.name: turn_id
columns.doc: Agent turn the take belongs to, if any (v_agent_turn.id).

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: Effort the take belongs to, if any (v_effort.id).

columns.name: budget_ms
columns.doc: The caller's time budget, if it had one.

columns.name: file_count
columns.doc: File rows recorded (0 when nothing changed).

columns.name: branch
columns.doc: Git branch currently checked out in the worktree.

columns.name: worktree_path
columns.doc: Absolute path of the stream's worktree.

columns.name: archived_at
columns.doc: Set when the stream was archived; NULL while live.

columns.name: ref
columns.doc: `symbol:<path>/<name>@snap:<id>`; a nested symbol's name is its container path (`Widget::spin`), and a name path's later symbols in a file (an overload, a setter after its getter) are numbered in position order (`Widget::value~2`). Unique.

columns.name: snapshot_id
columns.doc: The snapshot the file's symbols were read at.

columns.name: container
columns.doc: The enclosing symbol path (`Widget`); NULL at top level.

columns.name: language
columns.doc: The language server that reported it (`rust`, `python`, …).

columns.name: line
columns.doc: Where its name is (what to jump to), 1-based.

columns.name: start_line
columns.doc: Where the whole symbol starts (a decorator or doc comment included, as the server reports it), 1-based.

columns.name: end_line
columns.doc: Where the whole symbol ends (its body included), 1-based: the lines `start_line`..`end_line` are the symbol.

columns.name: files_collected
columns.doc: Changed files whose symbols were read.

columns.name: files_over_budget
columns.doc: Changed files skipped for the bound.

columns.name: files_without_server
columns.doc: Changed files whose language had no running server (the collector never starts one).

columns.name: files_failed
columns.doc: Changed files the server was asked about but failed on (an error, or no answer in time); they count against the bound.

columns.name: sha
columns.doc: The commit it points at (v_commit.sha); annotated tags peeled.

columns.name: stream_id
columns.doc: The thread's stream; NULL for backlog tasks.

columns.name: parent_id
columns.doc: Parent task (an epic); NULL at top level.

columns.name: author
columns.doc: Who the task came from: `user` or `agent`.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.doc: When the task reached `done`; kept if it is then archived, cleared if reopened.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: Thread the link was made in.

columns.name: task_id
columns.doc: Task it's attached to, if a task note.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: Thread it's attached to, if a thread note.

columns.name: classname
columns.doc: Grouping path (module path, file·class, describe path).

columns.name: time_ms
columns.doc: Its duration, when the report gave one.

columns.name: branch
columns.doc: Branch checked out when it ran; empty when unknown.

columns.name: last_ms
columns.doc: Its duration in its latest timed run, in milliseconds.

columns.name: max_ms
columns.doc: Its longest duration in any run.

columns.name: mean_ms
columns.doc: Its mean duration across its timed runs.

columns.name: flips
columns.doc: Times its status changed from one run to the next: how flaky it is.

columns.name: last_failed_at
columns.doc: When it last failed; NULL if never.

columns.name: last_passed_at
columns.doc: When it last passed; NULL if never.

columns.name: id
columns.doc: Run id; `run:<id>` is how claims and decisions cite it.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: Thread whose agent ran it, if known.

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: Effort it belongs to: the one that claimed it, else the one open when it ran.

columns.name: total
columns.doc: Tests run in total (NULL when not reported).

columns.name: provenance
columns.doc: `observed` (oxplow parsed a report) or `asserted` (an agent reported counts).

columns.name: branch
columns.doc: Branch checked out when it ran.

columns.name: closest_vcs_rev
columns.doc: The VCS revision (a git sha) the tested tree was at or nearest to.

columns.name: id
columns.doc: Run id; `run:<id>` is how claims and decisions cite it.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: Thread whose agent ran it, if known.

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: Effort it belongs to: the one that claimed it, else the one open when it ran.

columns.name: total
columns.doc: Tests run in total (NULL when not reported).

columns.name: provenance
columns.doc: `observed` (oxplow parsed a report) or `asserted` (an agent reported counts).

columns.name: branch
columns.doc: Branch checked out when it ran.

columns.name: closest_vcs_rev
columns.doc: The VCS revision (a git sha) the tested tree was at or nearest to.

columns.name: turn_id
columns.doc: The agent turn it ran in (v_agent_turn.id), if it ran in one.

columns.name: agent
columns.doc: Agent harness: `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, or `acp` (an Agent Client Protocol agent).

columns.name: closed_at
columns.doc: Set when the thread was closed.

columns.name: archived_at
columns.doc: Set when the thread was archived.

columns.name: acp_agent
columns.doc: For an `acp` thread, which ACP agent it runs (`claude`, `gemini`, a project `acpAgents` name); NULL otherwise.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.doc: The thread it was shown in (v_thread.id).

columns.name: turn_id
columns.doc: The turn it was shown in (v_agent_turn.id), when one was open.

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: The effort open in the thread at the time, if any.

columns.name: lens
columns.doc: An existing lens shown (`<extension>/<slug>`); NULL when the answer has its own spec.

columns.name: spec
columns.doc: The answer's own lens spec (JSON: title, query, viz, columns, chart, …); NULL for an existing lens.

columns.name: params
columns.doc: The params it ran with (JSON object).

columns.name: kept_lens
columns.doc: The lens it was kept as (`lens.keep`), if it was.

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: Effort open at the time, if any.

columns.name: turn_id
columns.doc: Turn it happened in (v_agent_turn.id), when known.

columns.name: prompt
columns.doc: The human prompt that opened this turn, if the transcript had one.

columns.name: cache_creation_input_tokens
columns.doc: Tokens written to the prompt cache.

columns.name: cache_read_input_tokens
columns.doc: Tokens read from the prompt cache.

columns.name: effort_id
columns.doc: Effort open at the time, if any.

columns.name: turn_id
columns.doc: Turn it happened in (v_agent_turn.id), when known.

columns.name: path
columns.doc: File it touched, repo-relative when inside the project.

columns.name: detail
columns.doc: Short context: the Bash command (truncated), a search pattern, the question an `await_user` call asked, …

columns.name: ok
columns.doc: 1 succeeded, 0 failed, NULL unknown (Bash often reports no exit code).

columns.name: event_id
columns.doc: The `agent.tool.finished` event (v_event.id) this row records; NULL for rows written before the event log carried tool calls.

columns.name: measure_key
columns.doc: Measure this is a value of (v_measure.key).

columns.name: subject_kind
columns.doc: What the fact is about: `file` or `symbol`.

columns.name: line
columns.doc: Line number, when it has one.

columns.name: dims_json
columns.doc: Extra dimensions as a JSON object.

columns.name: stream_id
columns.doc: The stream (worktree) whose tree it describes.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.doc: When the capture that holds it ran.

columns.name: payload_json
columns.doc: What the renderer recorded about it (JSON; a `key` / `slug` / `path` / `id` names the thing).

columns.name: state
columns.doc: Canonical state: `todo`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `done` or `canceled`. oxplow: `ready` is `todo`; `archived` is `done` when it was completed, else `canceled`.

columns.name: native_state
columns.doc: The provider's own state (oxplow: the task status, `archived` included).

columns.name: native
columns.doc: Provider-specific fields as JSON (oxplow: priority, thread_id, sort_index, author, completed_at).

columns.name: parent_ref
columns.doc: The parent work item's ref (an epic); NULL at top level or when the parent is deleted.

columns.name: ref
columns.doc: `comment:cmt<n>`: the search kind and the comment.

columns.name: body
columns.doc: The quote, then every message, a line each.

columns.name: ref
columns.doc: `note:not<n>`: the search kind and the note.

columns.name: title
columns.doc: Empty: a note has no title.

columns.name: ref
columns.doc: `task:tsk<n>`: the search kind and the task.

columns.name: body
columns.doc: Its id (so typing `tsk42` finds it), then its description.

columns.name: stream_id
columns.doc: Its thread's stream (`str1`); NULL for a backlog task.

columns.name: stream_id
columns.doc: Always NULL: wiki pages are project-global.
